verses.text: All Israel gather come meet David for Hebron and talk say, “Look, we be your bone and your flesh.

For di past, even when Saul still be king, na you dey lead Israel go out and come in. Di Lord your God talk to you say, ‘You go be shepherd of my people Israel, and you go be prince over my people Israel.’”
So all di elders of Israel come meet di king for Hebron, and David make covenant with dem for Hebron before di Lord. Dem anoint David king over Israel, as di word of di Lord wey e talk by Samuel.
David and all Israel go Jerusalem, wey be Jebus, and di Jebusites dey there, di people wey dey stay for di land.
Di people wey dey stay for Jebus talk to David say, “You no go enter here.” But David take di strong place of Zion, wey be David city.
David talk say, “Anybody wey first strike di Jebusites go be chief and captain.” Joab, Zeruiah pikin, go up first, and dem make am chief.
David dey stay for di strong place, so dem call am David city.
E build di city round, from Millo reach round am, and Joab repair di rest of di city.
David grow bigger and bigger, because di Lord of Armies dey with am.
Now dis na di chief of David brave men, wey make dem strong with am for im kingdom, with all Israel, to make am king, as di word of di Lord about Israel.
Dis na di number of di brave men wey David get: Jashobeam, one Hachmonite pikin, chief of di 30. E lift up im spear against 300 and kill dem one time.
After am na Eleazar, Dodo pikin, di Ahohite, wey be one of di three brave men.
E dey with David for Pasdammim, and di Philistines gather dey for battle, for one piece of ground wey full of barley, and di people run from di Philistines.
Dem stand for di middle of di ground, defend am and kill di Philistines. Di Lord save dem with big victory.
Three of di 30 chief men go down to di rock to David, enter di cave of Adullam, as di army of di Philistines camp for di valley of Rephaim.
David dey for di strong place then, and di Philistines garrison dey for Bethlehem.
David long for water and talk say, “Oh, if somebody go give me water to drink from di well of Bethlehem wey dey by di gate!”
Di three break through di camp of di Philistines, draw water from di well of Bethlehem wey dey by di gate, take am and bring am to David. But David no wan drink am, and e pour am out to di Lord.

E talk say, “Make my God no let me do dis thing. I go drink di blood of dis men wey put dem life for danger? Because dem put dem life for danger bring am.” So e no wan drink am. Dis na di things wey di three brave men do.
Abishai, Joab brother, na chief of di three. E lift up im spear against 300 and kill dem, and e get name among di three.
From di three, e honorable pass di two, and e become dem captain, but e no reach di first three.
Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, wey be pikin of one brave man from Kabzeel, wey do big things, kill two lion like men of Moab. E go down and kill one lion inside pit for time of snow.

E kill one Egyptian too, one big man, five cubits tall. For di Egyptian hand na spear like weaver beam, but e go down to am with staff, pull di spear from di Egyptian hand and kill am with im own spear.
Dis na di things wey Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, do, and e get name among di three brave men.
Look, e honorable pass di 30, but e no reach di first three. David put am over im guard.
Di brave men of di armies na Asahel, Joab brother, Elhanan, Dodo pikin, from Bethlehem,
Shammoth di Harorite, Helez di Pelonite,
Ira, Ikkesh pikin, di Tekoite, Abiezer di Anathothite,
Sibbecai di Hushathite, Ilai di Ahohite,
Maharai di Netophathite, Heled, Baanah pikin, di Netophathite,
Ithai, Ribai pikin, from Gibeah of Benjamin pikin dem, Benaiah di Pirathonite,
Hurai from di brooks of Gaash, Abiel di Arbathite,
Azmaveth di Baharumite, Eliahba di Shaalbonite,
Hashem di Gizonite pikin dem, Jonathan, Shagee pikin, di Hararite,
Ahiam, Sacar pikin, di Hararite, Eliphal, Ur pikin,
Hepher di Mecherathite, Ahijah di Pelonite,
Hezro di Carmelite, Naarai, Ezbai pikin,
Joel, Nathan brother, Mibhar, Hagri pikin,
Zelek di Ammonite, Naharai di Berothite, wey carry armor for Joab, Zeruiah pikin,
Ira di Ithrite, Gareb di Ithrite,
Uriah di Hittite, Zabad, Ahlai pikin,
Adina, Shiza pikin, di Reubenite, chief of di Reubenites, and 30 with am,
Hanan, Maacah pikin, and Joshaphat di Mithnite,
Uzzia di Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel, Hotham di Aroerite pikin dem,
Jediael, Shimri pikin, and Joha im brother, di Tizite,
Eliel di Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah, Elnaam pikin dem, and Ithmah di Moabite,
Eliel, Obed and Jaasiel di Mezobaite.
Now dis na di ones wey come to David for Ziklag, as e still dey hide because of Saul, Kish pikin. Dem dey among di brave men, wey help am for war.
Dem carry bow, and dem fit use right hand and left hand to throw stones and shoot arrows from di bow. Dem na from Benjamin, Saul relatives.
Ahiezer di chief, and Joash, Shemaah di Gibeathite pikin dem, Jeziel and Pelet, Azmaveth pikin dem, Beracah and Jehu di Anathothite,
Ishmaiah di Gibeonite, brave man among di 30 and over di 30, Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan and Jozabad di Gederathite,
Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah and Shephatiah di Haruphite,
Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer and Jashobeam, di Korahites,
Joelah and Zebadiah, Jeroham pikin dem, from Gedor.

From di Gadites, some separate to David for di strong place for di wilderness, brave and mighty men, men wey dem train for war, wey fit handle shield and spear, wey dem face be like di face of lions, and wey fast like gazelles for di mountains:
Ezer di chief, Obadiah di second, Eliab di third,
Mishmannah di fourth, Jeremiah di fifth,
Attai di sixth, Eliel di seventh,
Johanan di eighth, Elzabad di ninth,
Jeremiah di tenth, Machbannai di 11th.
Dis ones na Gad pikin dem, captains of di army. Di least among dem dey equal to 100, and di greatest dey equal to 1,000.
Dis na di ones wey cross Jordan for di first month, when e don overflow all im banks, and dem drive away all di people for di valleys, both toward di east and toward di west.
Some of Benjamin pikin dem and Judah pikin dem come to David for di strong place.

David go out to meet dem and answer dem say, “If una come to me for peace to help me, my heart go join una, but if una come to betray me to my enemies, as no wrong dey my hands, make di God of our papa dem see am and rebuke am.”

Den di Spirit come on Amasai, chief of di 30, and e talk say, “We be your own, David, and we dey your side, you Jesse pikin. Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, because your God dey help you.” Den David receive dem and make dem captains of di band.

Some from Manasseh fall to David too, when e come with di Philistines against Saul for battle, but dem no help dem, because di lords of di Philistines send am go after dem talk say, “E go fall to im oga Saul, and e go cost our heads.”
As e dey go Ziklag, from Manasseh fall to am Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu and Zillethai, heads of thousands wey dey Manasseh.
Dem help David against di band of robbers, because all of dem na brave and mighty men, and dem be captains for di army.
Because from day to day men dey come to David to help am, until e become big army, like God army.
Dis na di numbers of di heads of di men wey carry weapons, wey come to David for Hebron to turn Saul kingdom to am, as di word of di Lord.
Judah pikin dem wey carry shield and spear na 6,800, wey carry weapons for war.
From Simeon pikin dem, brave and mighty men for war, 7,100.
From Levi pikin dem 4,600.
Jehoiada na leader of Aaron house, and 3,700 dey with am,
and Zadok, one young man wey be brave and mighty man, and from im papa house 22 captains.
From Benjamin pikin dem, Saul relatives, 3,000, because till dat time di most of dem still dey keep watch for Saul house.
From Ephraim pikin dem 20,800, brave and mighty men, famous men for dem papa dem houses.
From half of Manasseh tribe 18,000, wey dem mention by name to come make David king.
From Issachar pikin dem, men wey understand di times, to know wetin Israel suppose do, 200 chiefs, and all dem brothers dey under dem command.
From Zebulun, ones wey fit go out for army, wey fit arrange battle with all kind of weapons of war, 50,000, wey fit arrange battle, and wey no get double heart.
From Naphtali 1,000 captains, and with dem with shield and spear 37,000.
From di Danites wey fit arrange battle 28,600.
From Asher, ones wey fit go out for army to arrange battle, 40,000.
From di other side of Jordan, from di Reubenites, di Gadites and half of Manasseh tribe, with all kind of weapons of war for battle, 120,000.
All dis ones, men of war wey fit arrange battle, come with perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel, and all di rest of Israel too get one heart to make David king.
Dem dey there with David three days, dey eat and drink, because dem brothers don prepare for dem.

Again, di ones wey dey near dem, even from Issachar, Zebulun and Naphtali, bring bread on donkeys, camels, mules and oxen, and food of flour, cakes of figs, bunches of raisins, wine, oil, oxen and sheep plenty plenty, because joy dey for Israel.
David consult with di captains of thousands and hundreds, with every leader.

David talk to all di gathering of Israel say, “If e good for una, and if e come from di Lord our God, make we send to our brothers wey remain for all Israel land everywhere, and with dem di priests and di Levites for dem cities and grazing land, so that dem go gather come meet us,
and make we bring di ark of our God back to us, because we no ask am for di days of Saul.”
All di gathering talk say dem go do so, because di thing right for all di people eyes.
So David gather all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt reach di entrance of Hamath, to bring di ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.
David go up, and all Israel, to Baalah, wey be Kiriath Jearim, wey belong to Judah, to bring up from there di ark of God, di Lord wey sit above di cherubim, wey dem call im name.
Dem carry di ark of God for new cart from Abinadab house, and Uzza and Ahio dey drive di cart.
David and all Israel dey play before God with all dem strength, with songs, harps, stringed instruments, tambourines, cymbals and trumpets.
As dem reach Chidon threshing floor, Uzza stretch out im hand to hold di ark, because di oxen stumble.
Di anger of di Lord burn against Uzza, and e strike am because e put im hand on di ark, and e die there before God.
David vex because di Lord don break out against Uzza, and e call dat place Perez Uzza till today.
David fear God dat day and talk say, “How I go bring di ark of God to my house?”
So David no carry di ark go im house for David city, but e carry am turn go Obed Edom di Gittite house.
Di ark of God stay with Obed Edom family for im house three months, and di Lord bless Obed Edom house and everything wey e get.
Hiram king of Tyre send messengers to David, with cedar trees, and masons and carpenters, to build house for am.
David know say di Lord don make am king over Israel, because im kingdom high well well, for di sake of im people Israel.
David marry more wives for Jerusalem, and David born more sons and daughters.
Dis na di names of di pikin dem wey e get for Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
Elishama, Beeliada and Eliphelet.
As di Philistines hear say dem don anoint David king over all Israel, all di Philistines go up to look for David. David hear am and go out against dem.
Di Philistines come and raid di valley of Rephaim.
David ask God say, “Make I go up against di Philistines? You go give dem into my hand?” Di Lord talk to am say, “Go up, because I go give dem into your hand.”
So dem come up to Baal Perazim, and David strike dem there. David talk say, “God don break my enemies by my hand, like water wey break through.” So dem call dat place Baal Perazim.
Dem leave dem gods there, and David command, and dem burn dem with fire.
Di Philistines raid di valley again.
David ask God again, and God talk to am say, “You no go go up after dem. Turn away from dem and come against dem opposite di mulberry trees.
E go happen say as you hear di sound of marching for di top of di mulberry trees, den you go go out to battle, because God don go out before you to strike di army of di Philistines.”
David do as God command am, and dem strike di army of di Philistines from Gibeon reach Gezer.
David name go out into all lands, and di Lord make all di nations fear am.
David make houses for imself for David city, and e prepare place for di ark of God and pitch tent for am.
Den David talk say, “Nobody suppose carry di ark of God except di Levites, because di Lord don choose dem to carry di ark of God and to serve am forever.”
David gather all Israel together for Jerusalem to bring up di ark of di Lord to im place wey e don prepare for am.
David gather Aaron pikin dem and di Levites together:
from Kohath pikin dem, Uriel di chief and im brothers 120,
from Merari pikin dem, Asaiah di chief and im brothers 220,
from Gershom pikin dem, Joel di chief and im brothers 130,
from Elizaphan pikin dem, Shemaiah di chief and im brothers 200,
from Hebron pikin dem, Eliel di chief and im brothers 80,
from Uzziel pikin dem, Amminadab di chief and im brothers 112.
David call Zadok and Abiathar di priests, and di Levites, Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel and Amminadab,

and talk to dem say, “Una na di heads of di papa dem houses of di Levites. Make una holy, una and una brothers, so that una go bring up di ark of di Lord, di God of Israel, to di place wey I don prepare for am.
Because una no carry am first, di Lord our God break out against us, because we no look for am as e suppose be.”
So di priests and di Levites make dem holy to bring up di ark of di Lord, di God of Israel.
Di Levites pikin dem carry di ark of God on dem shoulders with di poles on am, as Moses command according to di word of di Lord.
David talk to di chiefs of di Levites to appoint dem brothers di singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments and harps and cymbals, to sound loud and lift up dem voice with joy.
So di Levites appoint Heman, Joel pikin, and from im brothers, Asaph, Berechiah pikin, and from Merari pikin dem, dem brothers, Ethan, Kushaiah pikin,
and with dem dem brothers of di second rank, Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed Edom and Jeiel, di gatekeepers.
So dem appoint di singers Heman, Asaph and Ethan to sound with bronze cymbals,
and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah with stringed instruments set to Alamoth,
and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed Edom, Jeiel and Azaziah with harps set to di Sheminith, to lead.
Chenaniah, chief of di Levites, dey over di carrying. E teach about di carrying, because e get skill.
Berechiah and Elkanah na doorkeepers for di ark.
Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer, di priests, dey blow di trumpets before di ark of God. Obed Edom and Jehiah na doorkeepers for di ark.
So David, di elders of Israel and di captains over thousands go bring up di ark of di covenant of di Lord from Obed Edom house with joy.
Because God help di Levites wey carry di ark of di covenant of di Lord, dem offer seven bulls and seven rams as sacrifice.
David wear robe of fine linen, as all di Levites wey carry di ark, and di singers, and Chenaniah, leader of di music with di singers, and David wear linen ephod too.
So all Israel bring up di ark of di covenant of di Lord with shouting, with di sound of horn, with trumpets, with cymbals, dey sound loud with stringed instruments and harps.
As di ark of di covenant of di Lord reach David city, Michal, Saul daughter, look out from window and see King David dey dance and dey play, and Michal hate am for im heart.
Dem bring di ark of God and put am inside di tent wey David pitch for am, and dem offer burnt sacrifice and peace sacrifice before God.
As David finish to offer di burnt sacrifice and di peace sacrifice, e bless di people for di name of di Lord.
E give everybody for Israel, both man and woman, one loaf of bread, one portion of meat and one cake of raisins.
E appoint some of di Levites to serve before di ark of di Lord, to remember, to thank and to praise di Lord, di God of Israel:

Asaph di chief, and di second to am, Zechariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed Edom and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and harps, and Asaph dey sound loud with cymbals,
and Benaiah and Jahaziel di priests with trumpets always before di ark of di covenant of God.
Den for dat day David first command say make dem give thanks to di Lord by di hand of Asaph and im brothers.
Give thanks to di Lord, call im name. Make im works known among di peoples.
Sing to am, sing praise to am. Tell of all im wonderful works.
Glory for im holy name. Make di heart of dem wey dey look for di Lord rejoice.
Look for di Lord and im strength. Look for im face always.
Remember im wonderful works wey e don do, im wonders and di judgments of im mouth,
una Israel im servant pikin dem, una Jacob pikin dem, im chosen ones.
Na im be di Lord our God. Im judgments dey for all di earth.
Remember im covenant forever, di word wey e command to 1,000 generations,
di covenant wey e make with Abraham, im oath to Isaac,
and wey e confirm to Jacob as law, to Israel as covenant wey no dey end,
say, “To you I go give Canaan land, di share of your inheritance.”
As una still be small for number, yes, very small, and strangers for di land,
dem waka from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
E no allow anybody to do dem wrong. Yes, e rebuke kings for dem sake,
say, “No touch my anointed ones, and no do my prophets harm.”
Sing to di Lord, all di earth! Show im salvation from day to day.
Declare im glory among di nations, im wonderful works among all di peoples.
Because di Lord great, and e suppose get plenty praise. Dem must fear am pass all gods.
Because all di gods of di peoples na idols, but di Lord make di heavens.
Honor and majesty dey before am. Strength and gladness dey for im place.
Give di Lord, una families of di peoples, give di Lord glory and strength.
Give di Lord di glory wey im name deserve. Bring offering and come before am. Worship di Lord for holy clothes.
Tremble before am, all di earth. Di world stand strong so tay e no fit shake.
Make di heavens glad, and make di earth rejoice. Make dem talk among di nations say, “Di Lord dey reign!”
Make di sea roar, and all wey dey inside am. Make di field rejoice, and everything wey dey inside am.
Den di trees of di forest go sing for joy before di Lord, because e dey come to judge di earth.
Oh, give thanks to di Lord, because e good, because im mercy no dey end.
Talk say, “Save us, God of our salvation. Gather us and deliver us from di nations, so that we go give thanks to your holy name and rejoice for your praise.”
Make dem bless di Lord, di God of Israel, from forever to forever. All di people talk say, “Amen,” and praise di Lord.
So e leave there before di ark of di covenant of di Lord Asaph and im brothers, to serve before di ark always, as di work of every day need,
and Obed Edom with dem brothers, 68, and Obed Edom, Jeduthun pikin, and Hosah to be doorkeepers,
and Zadok di priest and im brothers di priests before di tabernacle of di Lord for di high place wey dey Gibeon,
to offer burnt sacrifice to di Lord on di altar of burnt sacrifice always for morning and evening, according to all wey dem write for di law of di Lord, wey e command Israel,
and with dem Heman and Jeduthun and di rest wey dem choose, wey dem mention by name, to give thanks to di Lord, because im mercy no dey end,
and with dem Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for dem wey go sound loud, and with instruments for God songs, and Jeduthun pikin dem to dey di gate.
All di people go, every man to im house, and David return to bless im house.
As David dey stay for im house, David talk to Nathan di prophet say, “Look, I dey stay for house of cedar, but di ark of di covenant of di Lord dey under curtains.”
Nathan talk to David say, “Do all wey dey your heart, because God dey with you.”
Dat same night, di word of God come to Nathan say,
“Go tell my servant David, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “You no go build house for me to stay.
Because I never stay for house from di day wey I bring up Israel reach dis day, but I don dey waka from tent to tent and from one tabernacle to another.
Anywhere wey I don waka with all Israel, I talk word to any of di judges of Israel, wey I command to shepherd my people, say, ‘Why you no build house of cedar for me?’”’
So now you go talk to my servant David say, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord of Armies talk: “I take you from di sheep pen, from following di sheep, so that you go be prince over my people Israel.
I don dey with you anywhere wey you go, and I don cut off all your enemies from before you. I go make name for you, like di name of di big ones wey dey di earth.
I go appoint place for my people Israel and plant dem, so that dem go stay for dem own place and no shake again. Wicked people no go waste dem again, as for di beginning,
and from di day wey I command judges to dey over my people Israel. I go defeat all your enemies. Again I tell you say di Lord go build house for you.
E go happen say as your days finish and you must go join your papa dem, I go raise your pikin after you, wey go be from your sons, and I go make im kingdom stand.
E go build house for me, and I go make im throne stand forever.
I go be im papa, and e go be my pikin. I no go take my mercy from am, as I take am from di one wey dey before you,
but I go set am for my house and for my kingdom forever, and im throne go stand forever.”’”
According to all dis words and all dis vision, na so Nathan talk to David.
King David come and sit before di Lord and talk say, “Who be me, di Lord God, and wetin be my house, say you don bring me reach here?
Dis one still small for your eyes, God, but you don talk about your servant house for long time to come, and you don look me as man of high rank, di Lord God.
Wetin David fit talk to you again about di honor wey you do your servant? Because you know your servant.
Di Lord, for your servant sake, and according to your own heart, you don do all dis greatness to make all dis big things known.
Di Lord, nobody like you dey, and no God dey except you, according to all wey we don hear with our ears.

Which one nation for di earth be like your people Israel, wey God go redeem to be im own people, to make name for you with big and wonderful things, as you drive out nations before your people wey you redeem from Egypt?
Because you don make your people Israel your own people forever, and you, di Lord, become dem God.
Now, di Lord, make di thing wey you talk about your servant and about im house stand forever, and do as you talk.
Make your name stand and make e great forever, say, ‘Di Lord of Armies na God of Israel, even God to Israel,’ and make di house of David your servant stand before you.
Because you, my God, don show your servant say you go build house for am, so your servant don find courage to pray before you.
Now, di Lord, you be God, and you don promise dis good thing to your servant.
Now e don please you to bless di house of your servant, so that e go continue forever before you, because you, di Lord, don bless am, and e dey blessed forever.”
After dis, David strike di Philistines and defeat dem, and e take Gath and im towns from di hand of di Philistines.
E strike Moab, and di Moabites become David servants and bring tribute.
David strike Hadadezer king of Zobah toward Hamath, as e go establish im rule by di river Euphrates.
David take from am 1,000 chariots, 7,000 horsemen and 20,000 foot soldiers. David cut di leg of all di chariot horses, but e keep some of dem for 100 chariots.
As di Syrians of Damascus come to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David strike 22,000 men of di Syrians.
Den David put garrisons for Syria of Damascus, and di Syrians become David servants and bring tribute. Di Lord give David victory anywhere e go.
David take di gold shields wey dey on Hadadezer servants and bring dem go Jerusalem.
From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David bring plenty plenty bronze, wey Solomon use make di bronze sea, di pillars and di bronze vessels.
As Tou king of Hamath hear say David don strike all di army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

e send Hadoram im pikin to King David to greet am and bless am, because e fight against Hadadezer and strike am, because Hadadezer dey fight wars with Tou. E send all kind of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
King David give dem to di Lord too, with di silver and di gold wey e carry from all di nations, from Edom, Moab, Ammon pikin dem, di Philistines and Amalek.
Abishai, Zeruiah pikin, strike 18,000 Edomites for di Valley of Salt too.
E put garrisons for Edom, and all di Edomites become David servants. Di Lord give David victory anywhere e go.
So David rule over all Israel, and e do justice and righteousness among all im people.
Joab, Zeruiah pikin, dey over di army, Jehoshaphat, Ahilud pikin, na recorder,
Zadok, Ahitub pikin, and Abimelech, Abiathar pikin, na priests, and Shavsha na secretary,
Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, dey over di Cherethites and di Pelethites, and David pikin dem na chief men by di king.
